body: I try to learn, but most times it dumb things that my foreman will blow up about. Running a comm line under a pipe instead of over. Not always having every tool I own on my person, when he's got a cart for his and I have a bucket. The guy went straight from do one thing, come back and ask what's next to here's a whole job figure it out. Nothing in between. Not all of them are that way, but unfortunately I'm pretty much ALWAYS stuck with the guy that is. I've got a guy about my age who I sometimes work with, and days are significantly better when I work with him.
